entries.name: High-Reach
entries.description: The elevated political and architectural heart of the Valerius regime, associated with the Spire, royal authority, and elite society.

entries.name: Kael-Vossen
entries.description: A vast horizontal elven metropolis protected by the Ley-Shield and built into living woodland rather than against it.

entries.name: Silt-Sinks
entries.description: A polluted and exploited region left damaged by magical extraction and imperial industry.

entries.name: The Rusty Tankard
entries.description: A location associated with Abel's life after leaving the High-Reach.

entries.name: Silk-Spinner Row
entries.description: A street district containing The Blind Weaver's Loom and The Iron Kettle Kitchen.

entries.name: The Root-Tap
entries.description: A tavern within Kael-Vossen's living architecture, used by Thrum and Kaelen as a place to gather information.

entries.name: Grand Sovereign Palace
entries.description: Queen Althaea's palace, grown into an enormous ancient redwood and surrounded by the living infrastructure of Kael-Vossen.

entries.name: Ancestral Root
entries.description: A foundational natural power source whose intake and preservation are central to the history of the continent.

entries.name: Zul-Thar Marshlands
entries.description: The marsh region tied to Kaelen Vane-Skar's family and Silt Guard history.

entries.name: Oakhaven
entries.description: An established location in the wider Aethelgard setting.
